note: Live recording of the four screens of deep-dive #1. Portal work is by a person; only prepare/teardown run as statements. Fictional invoices from samples/out.
prepare: # owner signs in (device code), not recorded
az login --use-device-code
$env:MG_TENANT = Read-Host 'Lab tenant short name for SharePoint URLs (owner types, never recorded)'
$env:PNP_CLIENT_ID = Read-Host 'PnP app registration client id (owner types)'
az functionapp list-flexconsumption-locations -o table
az provider register --namespace Microsoft.PowerPlatform --wait
python -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt
python samples/make_samples.py
az group create -n rg-mglab-deep-dive-01 -l westeurope -o none
az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-01 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam --query properties.outputs -o json > $env:TEMP\docintel-outputs.json
$out = Get-Content $env:TEMP\docintel-outputs.json | ConvertFrom-Json
Push-Location src; func azure functionapp publish $out.functionAppName.value; Pop-Location
$env:MG_KV01 = 'kv-mgl01-' + (-join ((97..122) | Get-Random -Count 6 | ForEach-Object { [char]$_ }))
az keyvault create -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-01 -n $env:MG_KV01 -l westeurope --enable-rbac-authorization true -o none
az role assignment create --role 'Key Vault Secrets Officer' --assignee (az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv) --scope (az keyvault show -n $env:MG_KV01 --query id -o tsv) -o none
Start-Sleep -Seconds 90   # role assignment propagation

az keyvault secret set --vault-name $env:MG_KV01 -n invoice-api-key --value (az functionapp keys list -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-01 -n $out.functionAppName.value --query functionKeys.default -o tsv) -o none
$env:INVOICE_API_URL = $out.extractUrl.value; python samples/smoke.py (Get-ChildItem samples/out/*.pdf).FullName   # off camera smoke test: fabrikam-clean Ready, other two Needs review
# manual: create SharePoint site /sites/finance-lab as labadmin if missing, with alex.demo as member (edit rights)
./provision/New-InvoiceInbox.ps1 -SiteUrl "https://$($env:MG_TENANT).sharepoint.com/sites/finance-lab" -ClientId $env:PNP_CLIENT_ID -WhatIf   # owner signs in
./provision/New-InvoiceInbox.ps1 -SiteUrl "https://$($env:MG_TENANT).sharepoint.com/sites/finance-lab" -ClientId $env:PNP_CLIENT_ID
./provision/New-InvoiceInbox.ps1 -SiteUrl "https://$($env:MG_TENANT).sharepoint.com/sites/finance-lab" -ClientId $env:PNP_CLIENT_ID   # second run: Exists for all 13 columns
# manual: edit the All Documents view (Name, Review status, Vendor, Invoice number, Total, Currency, Confidence, Review reasons)

# manual: Power Automate, solution 'Invoice intake' in DEV as labadmin: environment variables mgl_SiteUrl, mgl_InvoicesLibrary, mgl_InvoiceApiUrl, mgl_InvoiceApiKey (Secret, Key Vault invoice-api-key); flow exactly as flow/definition.json (Get API key with secure inputs and outputs, Extract invoice HTTP with exponential retry, Find duplicates, Final status, Update file properties, failure branch); turn it on
# manual: leave the library empty: the three PDFs are uploaded on camera in the first screen

screens.name: library-upload
steps: Sign in as Alex Demo (own browser profile) and open the Invoices Inbox library, All Documents view
Upload the three files from samples/out: fabrikam-clean.pdf, fabrikam-over-limit.pdf, fabrikam-mismatch.pdf (drag them into the library)
Wait for the three rows to appear and hold: Review status Pending, all other invoice columns empty
Show Created by / Modified by = Alex Demo
mask: tenant name in the address bar and the suite bar
user names and avatars other than Alex Demo (labadmin's name masked)

screens.name: flow-run
steps: Solutions > Invoice intake > open the flow Invoice intake > 28-day run history (wait 1 to 5 minutes after the upload: the trigger polls)
Open the run for fabrikam-mismatch.pdf: all actions green
Expand Get API key: 'Content not shown due to security configuration'
Expand Extract invoice briefly (inputs are secured), then Update file properties
mask: environment name and ID in the top bar and address bar
function app host name in the HTTP action
tenant name and user e-mail in the account menu
any GUIDs in the run URL

screens.name: library-results
steps: Open Invoices Inbox, All Documents, refresh until all three runs are done (1 to 5 minutes)
Show fabrikam-clean.pdf: Ready, Vendor, Invoice number, Total 1476, EUR, Confidence
Show the other two rows: Needs review
Do not edit any value by hand
mask: tenant name in the address bar and the suite bar
user names and avatars other than Alex Demo (labadmin's name masked)

screens.name: review-reasons
steps: Select fabrikam-mismatch.pdf and open the Details pane (or the edit form)
Show Review reasons: Subtotal + tax (1467.00) does not match total (1476.00).
Scroll once to show Vendor, Invoice number and Confidence
mask: tenant name in the address bar and the suite bar
user names and avatars other than Alex Demo (labadmin's name masked)

teardown: az keyvault purge -n $env:MG_KV01 --location westeurope   # run once the group delete has finished (soft delete keeps the name)
Remove-Item $env:TEMP\docintel-outputs.json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item Env:INVOICE_API_URL, Env:MG_KV01 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# manual: Power Automate: turn off and delete the 'Invoice intake' flow and solution (with its environment variables) in DEV
# manual: SharePoint: delete the Invoices Inbox library; remove the PnP app registration only if it was created just for this episode
